rows.TEXT: In his youth, this mighty lord once stood fast against an army from hell and single-handedly defeated them by sealing the gateway that spew them. He then became sovereign of his realm.

Highest lord of the dwarf lords, he is known for his intensity in battle and his courage in the face of overwhelming odds. He once fought seven days and nights against the mighty red dragon ARFURUZON to finally defeat him.

Every child trembles at the hearing of this most infamous name. This lord of hell is known for her blood thirsts. It is said that she once ate 1000 slaves at a banquet given by Bethrezen for a victory against the kingdom of light.

Known in his times as the mightiest of all adepts of the black art, this lord was slain by the inquisitor Vorgel who ended his reign of terror. He is now resurrected as an undead with the intention to subjugate every mortal to his will.

"You have brought me great pride, my Clans! Never would I have expected our strength to reach this level. Never would I have expected to see us united and working with our former enemies."

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"Wotan has granted us a great victory here, and here is where we will begin a new era of change. No longer will the Dwarves be manipulated by their enemies!"

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"Prepare for battle, Dwarves! Mortis poisons our lands, her hatred affects everything in its midst!"

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"We must wipe the scourge of Mortis from Nevendaar. Many of you feel we have failed Wotan's task. I tell you, it never existed! We will show our worth to him by punishing those who would taint his name!"

Venerable Warrior 
"Queen Yataa'Halli speaks the truth! We will march to the capital of the Undead Hordes and we will tear it down! Many of us will die gloriously in battle - our names will be legendary! For Wotan!"

Elf Queen Drullia'an 
"We have heard much of your recent deeds, Dwarves. The Dark Elf slain, the skirmishes with Undead forces. Though it saddens us to hear of Lachla'an's fate, we do owe you our gratitude for putting an end to his torment."

Elf Queen Drullia'an 
"A new respect for the Dwarven people flows through the populace. We hope that this respect will be returned while you travel our lands..."

Elf Queen Drullia'an
"I see that we now seek the same end... I must ask you - would you agree to fight alongside the Elves?"

Elf Queen Drullia'an

Phantom Warrior 
"By Mortis' decree - no living thing shall pass through these gates!"

Mountaineer 
"Here it is! A horrible monument to Mortis' depravity."

Flamecaster 
"Gah! What is that? It sounds like the screaming of a million tortured souls!"

Grave Golem 
"We wake. And we sssense life."
Take the Undead Capital. The Undead guardian must be destroyed.

Forest Elf 
"Half-men! Have Mortis' slaves reached your shores? We have been tracking them; her minions may hold one of our prophets; one of extreme importance to our people!"

Dwarf 
"Stolen by the Undead? What interest have the Undead Hordes in your religion?"

Forest Elf 
"More than you would know...Mortis once ruled the Elves alongside Gallean. She was then called Salonielle. She was beautiful, powerful, our Elven goddess; the goddess of life itself..."

Forest Elf 
"Though you certainly have a different history of Gallean's battle with Wotan, the outcome is no doubt the same.  The loss of her husband corrupted Mortis' soul. She hates my people, those whom she once cherished and protected..."

Venerable Warrior 
"I believe we have seen this prophet you seek.  We encountered a creature calling himself the son of Gallean.  But this was no holy man. His soul was twisted, as well as his body."

Forest Elf 
"No! Then it is true! We had received rumors of Lachla'an's fate, but thought them to be tricks to throw us off of his trail. Please, you must share this with our Queen. Seek our people to the South..."

Elf Queen Drullia'an
"Welcome, Dwarves! We are pleased at the possibility of peace between our people."

Dwarf 
"We now share a common cause. Our past holds no love between our people, but perhaps that will change."

Elf Queen Drullia'an
"Let us begin our attack on the morrow! Our armies will trust in the war experience of your people, you may trust in our arcane abilities."

Queen Yataa'Halli 
"I join you now, father! Wotan protect my people..."

Druidess 
"Death crawls over the stonework of this once regal palace."

Alchemist 
"Yes, look - the adornments of a more civilized culture."

Dwarf 
"Mortis took this place to house her minions. I cannot believe that Mortis, bringer of  plagues, was once a Goddess of the Elves! Why did her purity desert her?"

Clan Lord 
"It was she who deserted purity! She wanted only to replace her husband, giving no thought to toppling those who opposed her. By focusing on her misfortune, she foolishly replaced her purity with hatred."

Mountaineer 
"The Barbarian raids claimed many cities. Once, this city housed citizens of the Empire. The Savage world persists against civilization."

Dwarf 
"Look, this orb glows with an unholy light!"

Archdruidess 
"Be careful! This must be an Orb of Fear, no doubt imbued with Mortis' black spells. We will us it to strike back at its maker!"

Crossbowman 
"We still have far to go before we face Mortis."

Forge Guardian 
"We should prepare for a hard trip. Further south we'll find a shop where we can replenish our supplies."

Druidess 
"When will peace come to Nevendaar? Are our lives always to be filled with strife? Why must even divine beings fight; as Wotan fought for us in the Ragnarok."

Archdruidess 
"We are all weary of these battles...but as disciples we must live in a world of our God's making. It is not for us to choose the life that we lead, its hardships and its joys are granted by Wotan."

Dwarf Champion 
"We'll have none of that. We've dug deep into the earth and smelled far worse. In my father's time this was a Dwarven stronghold. It was abandoned a long time ago..."

Rune Master 
"We are in the Empire's domain. Garrell's Keep was once under Emperor Demosthene's rule, but I hear that it had separated from the Empire.."

King's Guard 
"Yes, the King has had to struggle to maintain his rule. The previous Emperor had a very weak hold on his subjects and many lords tried to overpower the throne. Thank Wotan that the Dwarves are not so foolish as to fight their own kind!"

Druidess 
"The banner fastened to this wall has magical properties! We should take it with us."

Empire Peasant 
"Please! Spare us! We do not oppose the Dwarves!"

Empire Peasant 
"Count Crowley hired mercenaries to guard his cities, they also serve to enforce his rule here. The citizens of Brisburg thank you for removing Crowley's army!"

Veteran 
"Quite the confederacy of thieves and bandits we have uncovered! Thank Wotan they were stopped before stealing our precious resources."

Grand Inquisitor 
"Crowley will not stand for your presence here. The Highfather protects his loyal followers. We will await you outside the castle walls - this battle is not over!"

Grave Golem 
"It isss time for usss to sssleep again."

Rune Master 
"What a foul creature! It was as if a graveyard itself had grown legs and marched to the defense of the city! Let us pray this sacrilege has been brought to an end. "

Rune Master 
"As we charge into the heart of Mortis' armies, we should make sure we have everything we need to face whatever guardian she has waiting for us. You! Begin to scour the merchants of these lands and see what you can gather!"

Rune Master 
"Don't be wasting any of those magical brews or mystic scrolls! We'll need them to protect us if we're to lay siege to Mortis' city! There's no way to know what sort of filthy beast she's got watching over it."
